howItWorks.title: How Arif Car Sell Works
howItWorks.subtitle: We streamlined vehicle transactions in Ethiopia into three secure and transparent stages.
howItWorks.buyerStep1Desc: Filter hundreds of verified Ethiopian listings by price, brand, condition, and location with high-resolution inspection photos.
howItWorks.buyerStep2Desc: Book a physical viewing and mechanical inspection at our secure partner centers in Addis Ababa with our licensed broker.
howItWorks.buyerStep3Desc: Complete title deed (Libre) verification and bank payment securely with our 1.5% fixed fee guarantee and zero surprises.
howItWorks.sellerStep1Desc: Share photos, registration libre, and asking price through our seller portal or WhatsApp support.
howItWorks.sellerStep2Desc: Our certified technicians verify condition and photograph your car, exposing it to 10,000+ serious buyers.
howItWorks.sellerStep3Desc: Receive 98.5% of the agreed vehicle price directly in your bank account upon signature. Zero hidden commission deductions.
